preferredPrimitives: components/ui/LoadError — every failed fetch surfaces here, with a retry
components/ui/Modal — bottom sheet on phones, centred card above sm
components/ui/TableCards — wraps a record table; restacks to cards below sm
components/people/kit — SummaryCard, StatusBadge, Table/Row, RowMenu, EmptyState
components/calendar/MonthGrid — the one month/week grid, reused by every calendar
lib/a11y clickable/toggleable — for controls that cannot legally be a <button>
lib/usePresence — holds an overlay mounted through its exit

must: Surface every failed fetch — a request that fails must never render as an empty state
Keep server-side capability checks; hiding UI is a second layer, never the guard
Indian money grouping on People/finance screens — lib/people money()
Name motion tokens --motion-*; --ease-out and --ease-in-out belong to Tailwind v4
avoid: Entrance/stagger animation on lists and tables — they are read on every page load
Route or tab content transitions — navigation is the app's most frequent action
Inventing data the schema does not hold (no 'late', no department, no overdue advances)
transition-all — use transition-surface or name the properties
Restacking a matrix (attendance month, availability grid) into cards

decisions.decision: Tables of records restack to cards below sm via TableCards; labels are read from the table's own <th> at runtime rather than hand-written per cell.
decisions.scope: invoices, expenses, contracts, reports, clients detail, settings, CloseCycleWizard, InvoiceDetailDialog

decisions.decision: Overlays animate: sheet from the bottom edge on phones, drawer from the right, toast from the bottom. Under 300ms, translate/scale/opacity only. Tailwind v4 emits the independent translate/scale properties, so transitions must name those rather than transform.
MonthGrid is a real ARIA grid: role=grid on the container, role=row week wrappers using display:contents so layout is unchanged, and every cell named with its full date and item count.
decisions.scope: calendar, my-calendar, client content calendars, PlanTab
